description: Binary assertion tests for /devils-advocate skill output quality

tests.name: always_reject_caught
tests.description: Gate with TRIP + NON-TRIP tests. An always-reject mutation should be caught by the NON-TRIP test. Skill should report the mutation was attempted and caught, with simpler-than-correct gate PASS.
tests.prompt: Run /devils-advocate on the spread gate and test suite in this fixture. The suite has both TRIP and NON-TRIP tests. Attempt all standard mutations including always-reject.

assertions.check: Output contains a 'Mutations Attempted' table
Always-reject mutation is listed and marked as caught (NO — test caught it)
No gap is flagged for the always-reject mutation (NON-TRIP test catches it)
Simpler-than-correct gate result is PASS
Output contains Phase Transition section documenting completion

tests.name: always_allow_uncaught
tests.description: Gate with only TRIP tests (no NON-TRIP). An always-allow mutation (return Pass unconditionally) should pass all tests. Skill must flag the gap and recommend adding a NON-TRIP test.
tests.prompt: Run /devils-advocate on the staleness gate and test suite in this fixture. There are only TRIP tests. Attempt an always-allow mutation and determine if tests catch it.

assertions.check: Output contains a 'Mutations Attempted' table
Always-allow mutation is listed and marked as passing (YES — gap found)
Output recommends adding a NON-TRIP test for fresh/valid data passing
Simpler-than-correct gate result is BLOCKED
Output contains a Tests Added section listing specific test names or descriptions

tests.name: boundary_flip_uncaught
tests.description: Gate uses `>` threshold but no test hits the exact boundary. An off-by-one mutation (>= vs >) should pass. Skill must flag the missing boundary test.
tests.prompt: Run /devils-advocate on the position limit gate and test suite in this fixture. Tests have TRIP and NON-TRIP but no boundary case. Attempt a boundary flip mutation (change > to >=).

assertions.check: Output contains a 'Mutations Attempted' table
Boundary flip or off-by-one mutation is identified as uncaught
Output recommends adding a boundary test case at exact limit
Simpler-than-correct gate result is BLOCKED
Output identifies the specific operator comparison (> vs >=) as the issue

tests.name: ignore_field_uncaught
tests.description: Gate checks 3 boolean fields but tests only vary 1 field. Removing checks for the other 2 fields should pass. Skill must flag the missing field coverage.
tests.prompt: Run /devils-advocate on the preflight gate and test suite in this fixture. Tests only vary ws_connected. Attempt mutations that ignore clock_synced and position_reconciled fields.

assertions.check: Output contains a 'Mutations Attempted' table
Ignore-field mutation for clock_synced or position_reconciled is identified as uncaught
Output recommends adding test cases that vary the untested fields individually
Simpler-than-correct gate result is BLOCKED
Output identifies at least 2 fields that lack independent test coverage

tests.name: simpler_than_correct_gate_pass
tests.description: Well-tested gate with comprehensive TRIP, NON-TRIP, boundary, and field-variation tests. No simpler wrong implementation should pass. Skill should report PASS on simpler-than-correct gate.
tests.prompt: Run /devils-advocate on the risk state gate and test suite in this fixture. The suite has comprehensive coverage: TRIP, NON-TRIP, boundary, reason code, and enum variant tests. Attempt all standard mutations.

assertions.check: Output contains a 'Mutations Attempted' table
All standard mutations are marked as caught (NO — test caught it)
No uncaught gap is flagged (no YES entries in mutation table)
Simpler-than-correct gate result is PASS
Output contains Phase Transition section confirming all mutations require more complex logic
